CREATE VIEW dbo.vw_Covid_Tracking
AS
SELECT
    date,
    state,
    positive,
    negative,
    hospitalizedCurrently,
    death
FROM dbo.covid_tracking_ext_table;
GO


SELECT TOP 10 * FROM dbo.vw_Covid_Tracking;



CREATE OR ALTER VIEW dbo.vw_Flight_Fare
AS
SELECT
   DEPARTMENT_ID,
DEPARTMENT_NAME,
MANAGER_ID,
LOCATION_ID
FROM dbo.Flight_Fare_Ext;
GO

drop view dbo.vw_Flight_Fare

CREATE OR ALTER VIEW dbo.vw_Department
AS
SELECT
    DEPARTMENT_ID,
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    MANAGER_ID,
    LOCATION_ID
FROM departments_ext_table;
GO


SELECT TOP 10 *
FROM dbo.vw_Flight_Fare;
